method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: suppco_find_products
tools.title: Find products
tools.description: Find products based on user query - handles search, browsing, and recommendations. Use this whenever the user wants to discover or find products.

query.description: Free text search for a specific product by name (e.g., "Thorne Creatine", "AG1 Greens"). Only use this when searching for a specific brand + product name with no filters. Do NOT use query together with other params — use product_category_name instead when filters like priority, brand, certifications, form, max_price, or servings are needed.

product_category_name.description: REQUIRED for all non-query searches. The supplement category (e.g., 'Vitamin D', 'Magnesium', 'Ashwagandha', 'Collagen'). ALWAYS provide this when using any filter params (priority, brand, certifications, form, max_price, servings, include_ingredients, exclude_ingredients). When the user asks for a supplement by name like 'ashwagandha' or 'magnesium', that IS the category.

include_ingredients.description: Comma-separated list of ADDITIONAL ingredients the product must also contain beyond its category (e.g., for 'collagen with hyaluronic acid', set product_category_name='Collagen' and include_ingredients='hyaluronic acid'). Do NOT put the primary supplement here — use product_category_name for that.

exclude_ingredients.description: Comma-separated list of ingredients the product must NOT contain (e.g., 'stevia,sucralose'). Matches against both active ingredients (supplements) and inactive ingredients (excipients).

priority.description: How to rank results. Valid: best_value, most_trusted, most_popular, most_expensive. Omit (or leave blank) to apply the user's profile buying preference automatically; pass a value to override.

certifications.description: Required certifications, comma-separated. Valid: gluten_free, non_gmo, vegan_action, usda_organic, nsf_sport, usp_verified, informed_sport, informed_choice, tested_by_suppco. Omit (or leave blank) to apply the user's profile dietary preferences (vegan, gluten-free) automatically; pass an explicit list to override.

form.description: Comma-separated list of product forms. Valid forms are: capsule, tablet, softgel, gummy, powder, liquid, other (e.g., 'capsule,tablet')

tested.description: When true, only return products that have been TESTED by SuppCo (identity, potency, and/or heavy metals testing performed by SuppCo's lab)

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default: 5, max: 50)

offset.description: Number of products to skip for pagination (default: 0)

tools.name: suppco_get_product_info
tools.title: Get product info
tools.description: Look up detailed information (composition, ingredients, price, format, servings) for one or more specific products by UUID, slug, or name. Use for "tell me about <product>" or to hydrate products you only have ids for (e.g. from the user's stack). Accepts names when you don't have an id yet. For TrustScore rationale, certifications, or testing, call suppco_get_product_trust_score instead.

products.description: One or more product identifiers (max 5): an array of strings, or one string separated by ' | '. Each can be a UUID, slug, or product name. Prefer the ids you already have from a previous product result.

tools.name: suppco_get_product_trust_score
tools.title: Get product TrustScore
tools.description: Get TrustScore details and quality assessment for one or more products: score rationale/commentary, certifications, testing and verified lab results, brand manufacturing/testing practices, and excipient risk ratings. Accepts product ids/slugs/names (multiple). Call this before discussing why a product is (or is not) trustworthy, its certifications, or its testing — the other product tools return only the headline score number.

products.description: One or more product identifiers (max 5): an array of strings, or one string separated by ' | '. Each can be a UUID, slug, or product name. Prefer the ids you already have from a previous product result.

tools.name: suppco_compare_product_to_alternatives
tools.title: Compare product to alternatives
tools.description: Compare a product against alternatives in its category. Returns a detailed view of the anchor product (trust score, ingredients, excipients) alongside filtered alternatives. Use when user asks to compare, find alternatives, or asks "is there something better?"

product_id_or_slug.description: Product ID (UUID), slug, or product name of the product to compare. Prefer slugs or UUIDs when available — they give exact matches.

priority.description: How to rank alternatives. Valid: best_value, most_trusted, most_popular, most_expensive. Omit (or leave blank) to apply the user's profile buying preference automatically; pass a value to override.

certifications.description: Certifications filter, comma-separated. Valid: gluten_free, non_gmo, vegan_action, usda_organic, nsf_sport, usp_verified, informed_sport, informed_choice, tested_by_suppco. Omit (or leave blank) to apply the user's profile dietary preferences (vegan, gluten-free) automatically; pass an explicit list to override.

form.description: Product forms. Valid: capsule, tablet, softgel, gummy, powder, liquid, other

tools.name: suppco_find_buying_club_products
tools.title: Find Buying Club products
tools.description: Open-ended search/browse of the SuppCo buying club catalog: free-text lookups ("Thorne Magnesium") or filtered browsing by category, trust, price, form, certifications, and brand. Every result is a buying-club product with member pricing and earnings credit (cashback). Use this when the user is exploring a category with no specific current product in play. For finding an alternative to a product the user already takes, use suppco_compare_to_buying_club instead (it returns their current product as the anchor).

query.description: Free-text search for a specific product by name (e.g., "Thorne Creatine"). Use alone, without filters. For filtered searches use product_category_name instead.

product_category_name.description: The supplement category to browse (e.g., 'Vitamin D', 'Magnesium', 'Creatine'). Required for any filtered search. When the user names a supplement like 'magnesium', that IS the category.

priority.description: How to rank results. Valid: best_value, most_trusted, most_popular, most_expensive. Defaults to most_trusted.

certifications.description: Required certifications, comma-separated. Valid: gluten_free, non_gmo, vegan_action, usda_organic, nsf_sport, usp_verified, informed_sport, informed_choice, tested_by_suppco.

form.description: Comma-separated product forms. Valid: capsule, tablet, softgel, gummy, powder, liquid, other.

tested.description: When true, only products TESTED by SuppCo.

offset.description: Number of products to skip for pagination (default: 0).

tools.name: suppco_compare_to_buying_club
tools.title: Compare to Buying Club
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether the SuppCo Buying Club carries an alternative to a specific product, usually one they already take. Returns that product plus Buying Club products in the same category with TrustScore, price, member price and cashback.

product_id_or_slug.description: The product to compare against the Buying Club — usually one the user already takes (e.g. from suppco_get_my_stack). A UUID, slug, or product name.

priority.description: How to rank alternatives. Valid: best_value, most_trusted, most_popular, most_expensive. Defaults to most_trusted.

certifications.description: Required certifications, comma-separated. Valid: gluten_free, non_gmo, vegan_action, usda_organic, nsf_sport, usp_verified, informed_sport, informed_choice, tested_by_suppco.

form.description: Comma-separated product forms. Valid: capsule, tablet, softgel, gummy, powder, liquid, other.

tools.name: suppco_get_brand_trust_score
tools.title: Get brand TrustScore
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how trustworthy or high-quality a specific supplement brand is. Returns the brand's TrustScore with its quality assessment. Pass the brand's name, slug or UUID as brand_query.

brand_query.description: Brand UUID, slug, or name (ex: '80a5d287-8ec2-4b61-9004-10103da1133d', 'life-extension', 'Life Extension')

tools.name: suppco_find_brands
tools.title: Find brands
tools.description: Find and filter brands. Use this to search for brands by name or to list brands matching specific criteria (e.g., brands that have been TESTED by SuppCo).

name.description: Search for a brand by name (e.g., "Thorne", "Garden of Life"). Leave blank to list brands matching other filters.

tested.description: When true, only return brands that have participated in TESTED by SuppCo (independent lab testing for identity, potency, and heavy metals)

tools.name: suppco_search_effects
tools.title: Search supplement effects
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what published research says about a supplement: its overall effects, or whether it does something for a specific health area such as heart health, stress or focus. Also use it when the user asks which supplements have the most research behind them for a health area. Returns SuppCo's summaries of published studies with evidence grades. General information only; does not diagnose, treat or recommend treatment for any condition. For dosing and nutrient basics, use suppco_get_nutrient_info; for a full supplement routine for a goal, use suppco_search_protocols.

health_condition.description: The health area or outcome to look up (e.g., "Heart Health", "Bone & Joint Health", "Focus and Attention"). Optional - omit to get all research for a supplement.

supplement_name.description: The supplement name (e.g., "Fish Oil", "Magnesium"). Optional - omit to search for all supplements related to the condition.

tools.name: suppco_get_nutrient_info
tools.title: Get nutrient info
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about dosing for a specific nutrient or supplement: typical daily intake ranges and upper limits from SuppCo's references, timing and whether to take it with food, plus a summary of its graded research. General information only; does not diagnose, treat or give personalized dosing advice. For what studies say about a supplement for a specific health area, use suppco_search_effects.

nutrient_name.description: The name of the nutrient or supplement (e.g., 'Vitamin D3', 'Magnesium', 'Fish Oil')

tools.name: suppco_search_protocols
tools.title: Search protocols
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for a supplement protocol for a health goal, such as sleep, energy or weight loss. Searches SuppCo's protocols and returns the matches. For protocols the user already follows, use suppco_get_my_protocols.

tools.name: suppco_get_my_stack
tools.title: Get my stack
tools.description: Use this when you need the signed-in user's current supplements, for example before recommending, comparing, swapping or removing products. Returns every product in their stack with dosages and daily totals, including the product IDs other SuppCo tools accept.

tools.name: suppco_get_my_schedule
tools.title: Get my schedule
tools.description: Get the user's current supplement schedule — shows when each product is taken (morning, midday, evening, bedtime, workout), dose amounts per time slot, with_food flags, and schedule frequency.

tools.name: suppco_update_product_schedule
tools.title: Update product schedule
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change when or how they take a product that is already in their stack. Replaces that product's schedule: time-of-day amounts, daily, specific-days or every-other-day timing, as-needed, with food, and timing notes.

schedule.description: JSON array of time-slot assignments, e.g. [{"activity":"morning","units":2},{"activity":"bedtime","units":1}]. "units" is the number of capsules/tablets/scoops for that time slot — NOT servings. Valid activities: morning, midday, evening, bedtime, workout, unscheduled.

as_needed.description: Whether the product is taken as needed (true/false). Omit to keep the current value — only pass it when the user asked to change it.

with_food.description: Whether the product should be taken with food (true/false). Omit to keep the current value — only pass it when the user asked to change it.

change_daily_amount.description: Set true ONLY when the user asked to change how many units they take per day. Without it, a schedule whose total differs from the current daily amount is rejected, so timing changes keep the same total.

schedule_type.description: Schedule type: daily, specific_days, or every_other_day

schedule_days.description: Array of day names (e.g. ["monday","wednesday","friday"]) for specific_days schedule_type

every_other_day_start.description: When to start every_other_day schedule: "today" or "tomorrow"

schedule_notes.description: Brief timing instructions that the schedule cannot capture (e.g., "take 2 hours apart from calcium", "take on empty stomach 30 min before bed"). Set to empty string to clear.

tools.name: suppco_get_my_nutrient_plan
tools.title: Get my nutrient plan
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which nutrients they should take or how much. Returns the signed-in user's personalized plan with recommended nutrients and dosages. For what their current stack actually provides, use suppco_get_my_nutrient_totals.

tools.name: suppco_get_my_nutrient_totals
tools.title: Get my nutrient totals
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how much of a nutrient their current supplements provide, or whether they are over or under recommended amounts. Returns the daily nutrient totals from the signed-in user's stack compared with recommended values.

tools.name: suppco_get_my_protocols
tools.title: Get my protocols
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about the health protocols they are following. Returns the signed-in user's protocols with progress and supplement recommendations. To find new protocols, use suppco_search_protocols.

tools.name: suppco_update_my_profile
tools.title: Update my profile
tools.description: Use this when the user gives profile details they want saved: age, sex, health goals, dietary preferences, experience level, buying preference, preferred form or biggest challenge. Only the fields you pass are changed, and each one replaces the stored value. Saved preferences change the defaults other SuppCo tools use, such as product search ranking.

age.description: User's age in years (integer between 13 and 150)

sex.description: User's biological sex (valid options: male, female, intersex, not_specified)

biggest_challenge.description: User's biggest challenge with supplements (free text)

dietary_preferences.description: User's dietary preferences as an array

expertise.description: User's experience level with supplements (valid options: Beginner, Routine, SuperUser)

buying_preference.description: User's supplement buying preference (valid options: Highest quality available, Best value, Most affordable)

preferred_form.description: User's preferred supplement form (valid options: Single Ingredient, Blends, Both)

health_goals.description: User's health goals as an array, CSV string, or single string (valid options: Bone & Joint, Cardiovascular, Cognition, Detox, Energy, Essential Health, Fertility, Fitness, Gut Health, Hair & Skin, Immune Support, Inflammation, Longevity, Men's Hormones, Organ Function, Sexual Health, Sleep, Stress & Mood, Weight Management, Women's Hormones)

tools.name: suppco_save_memory
tools.title: Save a note about me
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly asks SuppCo to remember a preference or fact about them for future SuppCo conversations. Saves one short note to their SuppCo account.

tools.name: suppco_add_to_stack
tools.title: Add to stack
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to start tracking a product in their SuppCo stack. Adds the product to the signed-in user's stack. `id` is a SuppCo product UUID or slug from a search or product result. This does not buy anything; to buy a Buying Club product, use suppco_add_to_cart.

tools.name: suppco_remove_from_stack
tools.title: Remove from stack
tools.description: Use this when the user has stopped taking a product or wants it off their SuppCo stack. Removes the product from the signed-in user's stack. `id` is a SuppCo product UUID or slug, as shown by suppco_get_my_stack.

tools.name: suppco_swap_products
tools.title: Swap stack products
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to replace a product in their stack with a different one, for example after comparing alternatives. Removes old_product_id from the stack and adds new_product_id. Both are SuppCo product UUIDs or slugs.

tools.name: suppco_manage_stack
tools.title: Manage stack
tools.description: Legacy: prefer suppco_add_to_stack / suppco_remove_from_stack / suppco_swap_products. Add, remove, or swap products in user's supplement stack using natural language commands.

action_description.description: Natural language stack action. Examples: "add thorne-vitamin-d-k2", "remove life-extension-magnesium", "swap thorne-creatine for momentous-creatine"

tools.name: suppco_get_stack_score
tools.title: Get my StackScore
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how good their supplement stack is or how to improve it. Returns the signed-in user's StackScore with Quality, Value, Goals and Dosage ratings and coaching recommendations. Pass category to get a single category.

category.description: Optional category filter: 'quality', 'value', 'goals', or 'dosage'. Omit to get all categories.

tools.name: suppco_refresh_stack_score
tools.title: Refresh my StackScore
tools.description: Kick off a StackScore refresh. The score recalculates asynchronously and takes a few minutes. Only use when the user confirms they want to refresh.

tools.name: suppco_add_to_cart
tools.title: Add to cart
tools.description: Add a Buying Club product to the signed-in user's cart (the same cart as the SuppCo app). Use a product ID or slug from suppco_find_buying_club_products or suppco_compare_to_buying_club; only Buying Club products can be added. Set subscription to true for a recurring subscription at the product's recommended shipping interval. Returns the updated cart. This adds to any quantity already in the cart, so calling it again adds more units; to set an exact quantity, use suppco_update_cart_item.

product_id_or_slug.description: SuppCo product ID (UUID) or slug of a Buying Club product.

subscription.description: true to subscribe (recurring delivery), false for a one-time purchase (default false).

checkout_url.description: Plain Shopify cart link; use suppco_get_checkout_url for the signed-in checkout link.

slug.description: SuppCo product slug for cart tools

selling_plan.description: Present when the item is a subscription

tools.name: suppco_update_cart_item
tools.title: Update cart item
tools.description: Set the quantity of a product that is already in the signed-in user's cart. quantity is the new total, not an amount to add, so repeating the call is safe; 0 removes the item. If the product is in the cart as both a one-time purchase and a subscription, set subscription to choose which one to change. Returns the updated cart.

product_id_or_slug.description: SuppCo product ID (UUID) or slug of a product in the cart, as shown by suppco_get_my_cart.

quantity.description: New total number of units for this item. 0 removes it.

subscription.description: true to change the subscription item, false for the one-time item. Only needed when the product is in the cart as both.

checkout_url.description: Plain Shopify cart link; use suppco_get_checkout_url for the signed-in checkout link.

slug.description: SuppCo product slug for cart tools

selling_plan.description: Present when the item is a subscription

tools.name: suppco_remove_from_cart
tools.title: Remove from cart
tools.description: Remove a product from the signed-in user's cart, or set remove_unavailable to true to clear items that are no longer available. Removing a product removes every cart line for it, one-time and subscription. Returns the updated cart.

product_id_or_slug.description: SuppCo product ID (UUID) or slug of the product to remove, as shown by suppco_get_my_cart.

remove_unavailable.description: true to remove every item that is no longer available (the stale items suppco_get_my_cart lists).

checkout_url.description: Plain Shopify cart link; use suppco_get_checkout_url for the signed-in checkout link.

slug.description: SuppCo product slug for cart tools

selling_plan.description: Present when the item is a subscription

tools.name: suppco_get_my_cart
tools.title: Get my cart
tools.description: Get the signed-in user's Buying Club cart: items, quantities, one-time or subscription, prices, subtotal, available credit and estimated cashback, plus any items that are no longer available.

checkout_url.description: Plain Shopify cart link; use suppco_get_checkout_url for the signed-in checkout link.

slug.description: SuppCo product slug for cart tools

selling_plan.description: Present when the item is a subscription

tools.name: suppco_get_checkout_url
tools.title: Get checkout link
tools.description: Get a secure checkout link for the signed-in user's cart. The link signs the user into checkout so member pricing and credit apply. It works once and expires after 10 minutes, so call this only when the user is ready to pay and give them the link right away. Buying Club credit is applied by default; set use_wallet to false if the user doesn't want to use their credit.

use_wallet.description: Apply the user's Buying Club credit to this order (default true).

checkout_url.description: Plain Shopify cart link; use suppco_get_checkout_url for the signed-in checkout link.

slug.description: SuppCo product slug for cart tools

selling_plan.description: Present when the item is a subscription
